text:
marta: Quick proposal — add a slim `@deploy-bot preflight` helper for quick checks before a release. Something like `@deploy-bot preflight --pin-check --summary` that returns pinned model/version, active change window, and a release-note skeleton. Low-friction, one-shot check.

lee: +1. Can it also surface canary config + current rollout %? We forget to set canaries a lot.

anika: I sketched a tiny release-note template we could return automatically. Example: 
```
Summary: short one-liner of change
Impact: services + expected latency/cost delta
Rollback plan: one-liner + runbook link
Canary: scheduled % and duration
Notes: migrations / db flags / infra changes
```
Would save time at the PR -> release handoff.

deploy-bot: prototype implemented in staging: `preflight --pin-check --summary --format=md` returns 
```
Pinned: model-v3.2 (pinned by @marta)
Change window: 2025-08-12 22:00-23:30 UTC
Canary: 5% for 30m -> 20% for 60m (current rollout 0%)
Release notes: [template attached]
Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/deploy-rollout-2025
Checks: config-lint ✅, db-migration-check ✅, kv-cache-warmup ⚠️
```
This is on the bot branch `preflight-helper` if anyone wants to try.

jay: Nice. Question: how does this interact with rollback flags? If preflight shows a KV cache warning, can we auto-set `--force-rollback` or just surface suggestion?

sasha: I vote for suggestion only. Auto-rollback from preflight is scary. But we should add a quick `preflight --suggest-rollback` that prints the exact deploy flags + command you'd run to rollback, e.g.:
```
# suggested rollback command
@deploy-bot deploy --to model-v2.9 --reason "kv-cache failure in preflight" --no-canary --tag rollback-1991234567
```
Also I'll add a tiny PR template that requires `preflight: yes` checkbox and paste of the bot output. That will make CI gating trivial.

marta: Love it. Can someone pick up the PR for `preflight-helper` and the PR template? I can shepherd the runbook links. @sasha wanna take the template?

sasha: I can draft the PR today, will ping for review. :raised_hands:

marta: Great — leaving this thread as the coordination point. I'll link the staging branch once CI passes. :thumbsup:
